title: Evaluating Aviation Safety Knowledge Extraction with SmolLM2: From Zero-Shot to Retrieval-Grounded Prompting
abstract: arXiv:2611.34432v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aviation accident narratives contain safety knowledge that is difficult to capture using structured occurrence fields alone. This study evaluates prompting-based knowledge extraction across four dimensions: concept accuracy, verbatim evidence grounding, structural compliance, and directed relation extraction. SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct was evaluated under zero-shot, one-shot, fixed few-shot, and retrieval-grounded prompting using 300 National Transportation Safety Board narratives from 2000-2020, containing 3,763 reference concepts and 467 directed relations. Evaluation combined structural checks, verbatim evidence matching, expert-reviewed semantic matching, and paired bootstrap confidence intervals. No prompting strategy performed best across all dimensions. Retrieval-grounded prompting achieved the highest concept micro-F1 of 32.27%, although its advantage over fixed few-shot prompting was uncertain (95% CI: -0.92 to 2.40 percentage points

translated_title: 使用SmolLM2评估航空安全知识抽取：从零样本到检索增强提示
translated_abstract: 航空事故叙述文本中包含仅靠结构化事件字段难以捕捉的安全知识。本研究从四个维度评估基于提示的知识抽取方法：概念准确性、逐字证据支撑、结构合规性以及有向关系抽取。研究使用2000至2020年间美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）的300份事故叙述文本（包含3,763个参考概念和467条有向关系），在零样本、单样本、固定少样本和检索增强提示四种设置下对SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct模型进行评估。评估方法结合了结构检查、逐字证据匹配、专家审核的语义匹配以及配对自助法置信区间。结果表明，没有任何一种提示策略能在所有维度上表现最佳。检索增强提示取得了最高的概念微平均F1分数（32.27%），但其相对于固定少样本提示的优势尚不确定（95%置信区间：-0.92至2.40个百分点）。
tldr: 该研究在300份NTSB事故叙述上系统评估了SmolLM2在四种提示策略下的航空安全知识抽取表现，发现检索增强提示的概念抽取F1最高（32.27%），但没有单一提示策略能在所有评估维度上占优。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates SmolLM2 for aviation safety knowledge extraction from 300 NTSB narratives under four prompting strategies, finding that retrieval-grounded prompting achieves the highest concept micro-F1 (32.27%), yet no single prompting strategy dominates across all evaluation dimensions.
